stem: Damini checks which expression must always be even for integer values of the letters. She compares $8p + 2r$ with $t^{2} + 3$.

options.text: $t^{2} + 3$ is always even because the added $3$ forces an even value.
Neither expression can ever be even for integer letter-values.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: $8p+2r$ factors as $2(4p+r)$, so it is always even for integers $p$ and $r$. For $t^{2}+3$, an odd $t$ gives an even value and an even $t$ gives an odd value, so it is not always even.

teacher.key_rationale: 8p+2r=2(4p+r) is always even. t^2+3 matches the parity of t^2 plus odd, so it flips with t and is not always even.
